content.text: -    Admin: daily    -    titrate slow    -    onset 2wk, 2-3M full effect
-    SE: agitation/irritability/anxiety    -    sedation OR insomnia    -    HA    -    GI    -    ED    -    sweating    -    abnormal bleeding/hyponatremia
-    Duration: t½: 1-3 d acute, 4-6 d chronic    -    norfluoxetine (active metabolite) 4-16 d    -    racemic 50/50 R/S
-    Duration: t½: ~21 h    -    potent selective 5HT reuptake (weak NE/DA)
-    Duration: t½: ~26 h    -    selective 5HT reuptake (weak NE/DA)
-    Monitoring: QT: d/c if persistent QTc >500 ms (dose-dep prolongation)
-    Duration: t½: 27-32 h    -    S-enantiomer (single isomer) of racemic citalopram    -    ~30x more potent than R-enantiomer (human SERT binding)
-    Admin: Taper: gradual    -    monitor like SSRI
-    MOA: major active metabolite of venlafaxine (O-desmethylvenlafaxine, ODV)    -    ⍉ QT prolongation (thorough QTc study)
-    Duration: t½: 5 h (ODV 11 h)    -    venlafaxine + active metabolite ODV = SNRI (weak DA)    -    ↓dose -> ↑5HT only    -    mod-high dose -> ↑5HT & NE
-    CI: high drug interaction    -    adjust hepatic dosage
Duloxetine (Cymbalta)- exception ends like SSRIs- careful! (best anxiety)
-    Clin Use: GAD (best anxiety)    -    DPNP, fibromyalgia, chronic MSK pain    -    depression
-    SE: GI (diarrhea, nausea)    -    irritability    -    liver toxicity    -    anticholinergic effects
-    CI: high drug interaction    -    ⍉ use if hepatic impair    -    ⍉ chronic liver dz/cirrhosis    -    ⍉ severe renal (GFR <30)
-    Caution: dose-related ↑HR/BP    -    renal dosing    -    ⍉ w MAOI
-    MOA: SNRI — NE > 5HT (3x potency in vitro)
-    Duration: t½: 6-8 h    -    55% unchanged in urine
-    Caution: HTN    -    tachycardia    -    serotonin syndrome risk    -    ⍉ chronic liver dz/substantial EToH    -    severe renal (CrCl 5-29): ↓dose 50%
-    MOA: block SERT/NET -> ↑[5HT/NE synaptic] (therapeutic)    -    block muscarinic/H1/α1-r -> anticholinergic/sedation/orthostasis (side effects)    -    tricyclic (CYP met)
-    SE: anticholinergic (xerostomia, urine retention, constipation, closed-angle glaucoma, blurry vision)    -    sedation    -    weight gain    -    orthostasis    -    reflexive tachy
-    SE: Overdose: sz    -    cardiovascular    -    narrow therapeutic index (lethal in OD)
-    Note: sedating TCA    -    inhibits NE + 5HT reuptake (tertiary amine)
-    Monitoring: plasma 50-150 ng/mL at doses >100 mg/day (only TCA w label target range)
-    Note: activating TCA    -    effect may occur w.in 1 wk
-    Clin Use: Enuresis (kids ≥6y): 25 mg 1 h b4 bedtime -> 50 mg nightly (<12y)    -    max 75 mg nightly (>12y)    -    depression
-    Note: 2ndry amine TCA    -    NE reuptake block > 5HT (most NE-selective)
-    Note: sedating TCA w anxiety-↓ component
-    MOA: weak block of DAT/NET -> ↑[NE/DA synaptic] (⍉ 5HT)    -    aminoketone (unrelated to TCA/SSRI)
-    Clin Use: depression    -    smoking cessation    -    ADHD (off-label)
-    SE: insomnia    -    anorexia    -    sz (↓ sz threshold)    -    HA    -    GI    -    xerostomia
-    CI: seizure disorder    -    eating dx (bulimia/anorexia — ↑sz risk)    -    abrupt EToH/benzo/AED w.draw    -    MAOI (w.in 14D)
-    Note: activating (⍉ sexual dysfun, ⍉ weight gain)    -    t½ ~21 h
-    MOA: block presynaptic α2 (autoreceptor) -> ⍉ autoinhibition -> ↑NE/5HT release    -    block 5HT2/5HT3 -> ↓anxiety/nausea    -    block H1 -> sedation
-    SE: sedation    -    weight gain    -    ↑appetite    -    constipation    -    hypercholesterolemia     -    tremor (when adj)
-    MOA: SARI — weak 5HT reuptake-i (-> ↑5HT) + 5HT2A antagonist (-> sedation, ↓anxiety)
-    Clin Use: depression    -    insomnia (off-label, 50-100 mg qHS)
-    Clin Use: MDD    -    less sexual dysfun than SSRIs
-    Caution: take w food (fasted AUC ↓~50%)    -    diarrhea, nausea    -    ⍉ w MAOI    -    t½ ~25 h
